description.zh: 用户的人脸图片URL下载地址，当前仅支持JPEG和JPG格式的图片，且图片URL中不能包含中文。
description.en: The URL for downloading the face image of the user. Only images in JPEG and JPG formats are supported. The image URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

description.zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
description.en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value as the **IsolationId** specified when you called the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add the user.

description.zh: 用户ID。请传入在调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的**UserId**值。
description.en: The user ID. Set this parameter to the **UserId** value that you obtained and saved locally after calling the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add the user.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。

    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。

- 请提前为用户的人脸图片，配置URL下载地址。

    > 当前仅支持JPEG和JPG格式的图片，且图片URL中不能包含中文。

- 调用该接口后，系统会返回用户人脸图片的唯一标识符（**Data**），建议保存该值到本地，以便后续调用其它接口时使用。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

- The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for invoking this operation is 100.

    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

- Configure a URL for downloading the face image of the user in advance.

    > Only images in JPEG and JPG formats are supported. The image URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

- After you invoke this operation, the system returns a unique identity for the face image (**Data**). Save this value locally for use when invoking other operations.
